product_overview: A desktop WPF patient registration module for managing laboratory patients, visits, ordered tests, barcode/print outputs, and result entry. It supports master-data-driven workflows with validation, LabId generation, and result flagging based on reference ranges.
core_goals: Register new patients with unique LabIds and validated demographic data
Assign lab tests to patient visits and calculate pricing
Support barcode, receipt, and worksheet printing for completed registrations
Enable result entry, reference-range validation, and High/Low/Normal flagging
Provide patient search and retrieval by key identifiers
Enforce transactional integrity, audit logging, and permission-based UI gating

features.name: Patient Registration & CRUD
features.description: Create, update, search, and manage patient master data with LabId generation, referral assignment, medical history, and validation rules.
user_flows: POST PatientService.CreateAsync(Patient) with valid FullName, Gender, and blank LabId -> System auto-generates unique LabId and persists patient -> Receive 200 with saved Patient and PatientId > 0 -> GET PatientService.GetByLabIdAsync(labId) -> Receive 200 with the created patient

POST PatientService.CreateAsync(Patient) with duplicate LabId or invalid Gender / future BirthDate -> Validation fails or duplicate is detected -> Receive 400 ArgumentException or 409 InvalidOperationException

CALL PatientService.UpdateAsync(Patient, userId) with changed patient fields and existing PatientId -> System validates referral and LabId collision, writes EDIT_PATIENT audit log, and saves changes -> Receive 200 OK

CALL PatientService.DeleteAsync(patientId) for a patient with no visits -> Patient is deleted -> Receive 200 OK -> CALL PatientService.DeleteAsync(patientId) for a patient that has visits -> Deletion is refused -> Receive 409 InvalidOperationException

features.name: Visit & Visit-Test Assignment
features.description: Create visits for patients, assign tests and custom groups, resolve pricing, and protect visit integrity as status changes.
user_flows: CALL VisitService.CreateAsync(Visit) for an existing patient with no explicit referral -> System creates an Open visit and inherits referral data when available -> Receive 200 with persisted Visit

CALL VisitService.AddTestToVisitAsync(visitId, testId, overridePrice?) on an Open visit -> System resolves price and creates VisitTest, enqueueing send-out tests when applicable -> Receive 200 with VisitTest
CALL VisitService.AddTestToVisitAsync(visitId, testId, overridePrice?) on a Closed visit or with a duplicate test -> System rejects mutation -> Receive 409 InvalidOperationException

CALL VisitService.RemoveVisitTestAsync(visitTestId) for an unverified test with no result -> System removes the VisitTest -> Receive 200 OK -> CALL VisitService.RemoveVisitTestAsync(visitTestId) for a verified test or one with entered results -> System refuses removal -> Receive 409 InvalidOperationException

features.name: Test Catalog & Referrals
features.description: Manage reference data required by registration, including tests, referral contracts, price lists, parameters, and reference ranges.
user_flows: CALL TestCatalogService.GetAllTestsAsync() -> System returns all tests ordered by NameReport -> Receive 200 with List<Test>
CALL TestCatalogService.GetReferralsAsync() -> System returns referrals ordered by Name -> Receive 200 with List<Referral>

CALL TestCatalogService.CreateTestAsync(Test) with required fields and valid pricing -> System persists the test -> Receive 200 -> CALL TestCatalogService.DeleteTestAsync(testId) for a test used by VisitTests or PriceListItems -> System refuses deletion -> Receive error due to dependency constraints

CALL TestCatalogService.CreateReferenceRangeAsync(TestReferenceRange) with valid numeric limits and age units -> System saves normalized range data -> Receive 200 -> CALL TestCatalogService.CreateReferenceRangeAsync(TestReferenceRange) with AgeFrom greater than AgeTo or no usable limits/text -> Validation fails -> Receive 400 or equivalent validation error

features.name: Result Entry & Verification
features.description: Store and verify test results, validate values against reference ranges, and transition visit-test status through the result lifecycle.
user_flows: CALL ResultsService.SaveResultAsync(visitTestId, parameterId, value, flag, comment[, userId]) with a valid value -> System inserts or updates the result and updates VisitTest status -> Receive 200 OK

CALL ResultsService.ValidateResultAsync(testId, parameterId?, value, gender, age, ageUnit?) -> System evaluates the best matching reference range and returns L/H/N plus comments -> Receive 200 with ReferenceRangeResult
CALL ResultsService.VerifyVisitTestAsync(visitTestId, userId) after all required values are entered -> System stamps verification metadata and marks the VisitTest Verified -> Receive 200 OK
CALL ResultsService.SaveResultAsync(visitTestId, parameterId, value, flag, comment[, userId]) for a Verified VisitTest -> System blocks further edits -> Receive 409 InvalidOperationException

features.name: Printing (Receipt, Worksheet, Visit Report, Barcode)
features.description: Generate and print patient-facing and technician-facing documents from persisted visit data and barcode inputs.
user_flows: CALL PrintService.PrintReceiptAsync(ReceiptData, barcodeText?) after a visit is saved -> System prints a receipt containing patient meta, ordered tests, and totals -> Receive print success
CALL PrintService.PrintWorksheetByPatientAsync(from, to, rows) with visit rows -> System prints a patient worksheet for lab staff -> Receive print success
CALL PrintService.PrintBarcodeImageAsync(title, image, barcodeText, info?) -> System prints a barcode label for the patient or sample -> Receive print success
CALL PrintService.PrintVisitReportAsync(VisitReportData, isReprint?) for a completed visit -> System prints the report with parameter values and previous-result annotations -> Receive print success

features.name: Patient Registration ViewModel (UI orchestration)
features.description: Coordinate patient, visit, invoice, barcode, search, and print workflows in the Patient Registration screen with permission and lifecycle gating.
user_flows: CALL PatientRegistrationViewModel.SaveAsync() with valid patient data and selected tests -> System saves the patient, medical history, and visit/invoice chain -> Receive success and the UI switches out of edit mode

CALL PatientRegistrationViewModel.LoadByLabIdAsync / LoadByCodeAsync / SearchAsync / LoadTodayPatientsAsync with a valid identifier or filter -> System populates the form and result grids -> Receive matching patients
CALL PatientRegistrationViewModel.ShowBarcode() after PatientId or LabId exists -> System builds barcode label data and sends it to printing -> Receive barcode output

CALL PatientRegistrationViewModel.SaveVisitAndInvoiceAsync() with selected tests but under SQLite using ambient transaction scope -> System may fail due to unsupported ambient transactions -> Receive runtime failure indicating transaction support issue

CALL PatientRegistrationViewModel.AddSelectedTest / AddAllVisibleTests / RemoveSelectedTest -> System updates the in-memory selected tests grid and removes persisted VisitTests when applicable -> Receive updated UI state

features.name: Patient Registration & CRUD
features.description: Core patient master-data workflow exposed by IPatientService and orchestrated by PatientRegistrationViewModel. Covers validation, normalization, LabId auto-generation, audit logging, transactional registration save, and referral-contract assignment.

endpoints.description: Validates business rules (FullName/Gender/LabId required, Gender in {Male,Female,ذكر,أنثى}, BirthDate not in future), validates referral contract existence, auto-generates LabId if blank, rejects duplicate LabId, persists patient.

body.Gender: string (required, must be one of Male/Female/ذكر/أنثى)
body.BirthDate: DateTime? (must not be in the future)
body.ReferralId: int? (must exist in Referrals if provided)

endpoints.description: Updates an existing patient, validates referral, prevents LabId collision with other patients, writes an EDIT_PATIENT audit log when any field changes. Phase 0 fix C-02 ensures Age, AgeUnit, IsVip, IsPregnant, HomePhone, NationalId, Email are no longer silently dropped.
Generates the next LabId for a given date using format yyyyMMdd + 3-digit sequence. Scans existing LabIds with the same date prefix, picks max+1, loops until candidate is unique.
Returns the patient with the given LabId, or null.
Filters patients by partial name, phone, lab id, and/or any visit on the given date. Used by both the "Search" form and the "Today's patients" quick list. Returns patients ordered by FullName.

Atomic registration: wraps Patient + Visit + VisitTests + Invoice in a single EF Core transaction (Phase 0 Fix #2). Validates business rules, generates LabId when missing, rolls back on any failure. Returns the new VisitId.
Refuses to delete patients that have any visit. No-op when patient does not exist.
Re-assigns the patient to a referral contract, requires positive userId, validates the referral exists, writes an ASSIGN_PATIENT_CONTRACT audit log when the value changes.
Reads or upserts the patient's medical history (chronic diseases, allergies, medications, notes + 6 boolean condition flags). Trims strings, requires the patient to exist on save.

depends_on: SessionContext / PermissionCodes (PatientsView / PatientsEdit gating in the ViewModel)

features.name: Visit & Visit-Test Assignment
features.description: Lifecycle of a lab visit and its assigned tests, implemented by VisitService. Enforces account-type rules (Cash vs Referral), prevents mutation of Closed visits, blocks removal of tests once a result has been entered, resolves test price from the referral's price list, and queues send-out tests on the external lab queue.

endpoints.description: Creates a visit for an existing patient. Inherits ReferralId from the patient if not set, forces AccountType=Referral when a referral is present, rejects Referral account type with no referral, defaults Status to "Open".

response_schema.409: InvalidOperationException (Referral account type requires a referral)

endpoints.description: Adds a test to an Open visit. Rejects duplicates and closed visits. Resolves price from the visit's referral price list (then default price list, then test.Price). Send-out tests auto-enqueue on ExternalLabQueues.
Removes an unverified visit-test. Refuses if Status==Verified, if any non-empty ResultValue exists for it, or if the parent visit is Closed.
Reads-only retrieval used for receipt / worksheet / results screens. Includes the Test navigation property when listing.
Adds every test in a CustomGroup to the visit, skipping ones already present.

features.name: Test Catalog & Referrals
features.description: Manages the master data the registration screen depends on: tests, groups, sample types, units, parameters, reference ranges, comments, price lists, custom groups, referrals and physicians. Used by PatientRegistrationViewModel to populate "Available tests" and the referral dropdown.

endpoints.description: Returns all tests ordered by NameReport. Backs the "Available tests" grid.
Returns all referrals ordered by Name. Backs the referral dropdown.

CRUD with validation: Code/NameReport/NameReceipt required, Price>=0, send-out tests require CostPrice and PatientPrice. Cannot delete a test used by VisitTests, PriceListItems, CustomGroupItems, or TestParameters.
Validates and normalizes age units (Day/Month/Year), projects AgeFrom/AgeTo to days for matching, refuses ranges without numeric limits AND without normal text, rejects AgeFrom > AgeTo.
Manages multi-component test parameters. Auto-numbers OrderNo if omitted, rejects duplicate parameter names per test, requires the parent test to exist.
Create/Update/Get for PriceLists and PriceListItems. Enforces one default per referral, rejects negative prices, blocks duplicate (PriceListId, TestId) pairs.

features.name: Result Entry & Verification
features.description: Implemented by ResultsService. Stores per-parameter result values with flags and comments, drives VisitTest status (Pending → InProgress → Completed → Verified), validates results against age/gender/parameter scoped reference ranges, logs EDIT_RESULT audits, and exposes the previous result for trending. Single-component tests use a single ResultValue with ParameterId=null; multi-component tests (e.g. CBC) use one ResultValue per TestParameter.

endpoints.description: Insert-or-update of a ResultValue. Refuses when the VisitTest is Verified. Recomputes VisitTest.Status: Completed only when every TestParameter has a non-empty value (single-component path falls back to "any ResultValue with a value"). Writes an EDIT_RESULT audit row when an existing value/flag/comment is changed and a userId is supplied.
Promotes status to Verified only when every parameter has a value (or, for single-component tests, at least one ResultValue exists). Stamps VerifiedBy/VerifiedAt on each ResultValue.
Reverses verification: clears VerifiedBy/VerifiedAt, sets Status back to InProgress. Idempotent for non-verified rows.

Finds the most specific reference range (prefer ParameterId match, then Gender match, age range in days) and tags the value as L/H/N. Returns the matched range thresholds plus DefaultComment / LowComment / HighComment for auto-commentary.
Returns the most recent prior VisitTest with at least one non-empty result for the same patient and test (drives delta-check on reports).
Bulk status transitions + PRINT_REPORT audit logging.

features.name: Printing (Receipt, Worksheet, Visit Report, Barcode)
features.description: WPF FlowDocument-based print pipeline implemented in PrintService. Builds Arabic-localized receipts, worksheet listings (by patient or by test), visit reports with prior-result trending, culture/sensitivity reports, free-form text reports, and barcode label outputs. The print queue is resolved per document type via ISettingsService, with a "Microsoft Print to PDF" fallback.

endpoints.description: Prints the visit receipt: header + patient meta + optional barcode text + per-test name/price/status + invoice totals (Total / Discount / NetTotal / Paid / Balance / Status). Called from PatientRegistrationViewModel.PrintReceiptAsync which rebuilds ReceiptData from DB state when a visit has been persisted.
Prints the patient worksheet (one row per visit: VisitId, date, patient name, tests count). Called from PatientRegistrationViewModel which derives the test count from DB after save.
Aggregated worksheet by test name with counts.
Prints a barcode label: ImageSource (Code-128 etc.), human-readable code, and an optional info line.
Prints the final visit report including per-test parameter values and previous-value annotations.
Prints culture & sensitivity report as an antibiotic/sensitivity/notes table.

features.name: Patient Registration ViewModel (UI orchestration)
features.description: Single orchestration surface that the Patient Module screen binds to. Wires Patient + Visit + Invoice + Barcode + Print + Navigation + TestCatalog into one MVVM controller. CanExecute rules tie every command to SessionContext permissions (PatientsView / PatientsEdit) and to lifecycle state (PatientId, CurrentVisitId, IsEditMode).

endpoints.description: Validates FullName, then creates or updates the patient, saves medical history, and chains into SaveVisitAndInvoiceAsync. Switches IsEditMode=false on success.

When SelectedTests is non-empty, opens a TransactionScope, creates a new Visit (or loads CurrentVisitId), adds missing visit tests, upserts the Invoice via IInvoiceService, then completes the transaction. Emits an Arabic status message and rethrows on failure.
Calls PatientService.GenerateNextLabIdAsync(today) only when PatientId==0.
Search/load surface — populates Results, QuickPatientsList, and the form.

Builds the barcode sample-label set: "Serum Fasting" when IsFasting, one label per selected test, plus extra sample-type labels (Blood / Urine / Stool / Semen / CSF). Refuses when neither PatientId nor LabId is set.
Loads visit/tests/invoice/patient from DB (or falls back to in-memory state for unit tests) and calls IPrintService.PrintReceiptAsync. Requires CurrentVisitId > 0.
Computes tests count from DB when a visit is saved, refuses when no tests are selected, then calls IPrintService.PrintWorksheetByPatientAsync.
Maintains the in-memory SelectedTests grid and triggers DB delete for already-persisted VisitTests on remove (G4.3).
Filters AvailableTests by category (TM=routine, CC=send-out, TG=all) and free-text search across NameReport/NameReceipt/Code.
"خالص" — sets PaidAmount so balance==0, calls IInvoiceService.CreateOrUpdateInvoiceAsync, rolls the paid amount into PreviousPaidAmount.

known_limitations.issue: PatientRegistrationViewModel.SaveVisitAndInvoiceAsync wraps work in a System.Transactions.TransactionScope, but EF Core + SQLite (the default provider in OpenLabDbContext) does NOT support ambient transactions. The same flow on SaveRegistrationAsync uses EF Core's explicit BeginTransactionAsync (Fix #2). The ViewModel path can still throw "ambient transaction not supported" when run against SQLite.
known_limitations.impact: Visit + invoice may not be saved atomically on SQLite-backed deployments.

known_limitations.issue: PrintService.PrintDocument always resolves to "Microsoft Print to PDF" via ResolvePrintQueue() rather than the type-specific printer returned by ResolvePrintQueueAsync. The async resolver is defined but unused by the synchronous PrintDocument helper.
known_limitations.impact: Receipt-vs-report printer routing from ISettingsService is effectively ignored.

known_limitations.issue: PatientService.DeleteAsync refuses deletion only when Visits exist; it does not also block when MedicalHistories rows exist, which can leave orphaned medical-history rows if the FK is not cascading.
known_limitations.impact: Possible orphaned MedicalHistory row after delete depending on schema.

known_limitations.issue: VisitService.AddTestToVisitAsync uses overridePrice when provided, bypassing the referral price list — which is the intended behavior but means the caller (PatientRegistrationViewModel passes the selected test's price) can save a price that does not match the contract.
known_limitations.impact: Contract pricing can be overridden by the registration screen without an audit trail.

known_limitations.issue: ResultsService.SaveResultCoreAsync skips the EDIT_RESULT audit row when userId is null/zero (e.g. when the legacy 5-arg overload is used by tests/UI code that does not pass a userId), so result edits made via that path are not logged.
known_limitations.impact: Audit gap for result edits made through the legacy overload.

known_limitations.issue: PatientRegistrationViewModel.GenerateLabIdAsync is called on every ClearFormAsync and on Initialize; if multiple registration screens are open simultaneously they can race to the same candidate LabId — Create will detect the duplicate but the user sees a "LabId already exists" error rather than a fresh ID.
known_limitations.impact: Race condition on concurrent registrations in multi-user installs.
